g.text: Initiation: The Prompter utilizes the configuration intent to trigger the initial command to the DUT.

g.text: Evaluation: It ingests the DUT's response and analyzes the array of previous inputs (the conversation history).

g.text: Routing: Based on this analysis, the Prompter's decision engine determines whether the conversation requires further clarification or has reached a natural conclusion.

g.text: Handoff: Once concluded, the Prompter packages the full agent state and forwards it to the Judge for the final PASS/FAIL evaluation.
